adjudication.rationale: In Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#save_host, the code unconditionally dereferences `params[:embeddable_host][:host]` and `params[:embeddable_host][:category_id]` (lines shown in the diff), so a request missing `embeddable_host` or `host` will raise `NoMethodError` before any validation/JSON error handling. Additionally, `update` and `destroy` fetch with `EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first` and do not handle the `nil` case; `save_host(nil)` (update) or `host.destroy` (destroy) would also raise, returning a 500. The model’s `before_validation` calling `self.host.sub!` further amplifies the nil-host crash path.
